name: Avro Studio
summary: Black-and-white interior studio site with a dim full-bleed room photo, a centred uppercase wordmark hero, a staggered project collage and stacking process cards.

fonts.pairing: Inter 500 uppercase for the hero wordmark, Inter Display 400 for section titles, Inter 400 for body; no second family

signature: background flips from black to white while the project collage scrolls through
staggered project collage with images of different sizes alternating left and right
process cards that pin and stack, scaling down to 0.9 as the next one arrives
imagery: moody AI-rendered interiors with warm raking light, gallery-white rooms with bold art, concrete halls; square crops, no radius
layout_grid: full 1440 frame with 30px side padding, 100 to 150px section padding, left-aligned headers, zero radius, hairline dividers only
